g.data-route: agreement at first reading: the Council approved the EP position

text.tspan: Legislative procedure – Cyber Resilience Act – Regulation (EU) 2024/2847

Procedure 2022/0272(COD). Route: agreement at first reading: the Council approved the EP position. Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see cra.html).
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading, or, after the EP first reading, to an early second reading.

text.tspan: • The Council vote approving the EP position (Art. 294(4) TFEU) took place after the I/A item note of 27 Sep 2024 and before the signature on 23 Oct 2024; its exact date is not in the sources used.

• Trilogues and the Coreper letter are informal steps, not part of Art. 294 TFEU; they follow the Joint Declaration on practical arrangements for the codecision procedure (OJ C 145, 30.6.2007, p. 5), points 7–14.

Labels are shortened; the procedure page lists every event in full with its document and source. Sources: EP Open Data API (procedure events), Cellar procedure file, Council register documents and agendas, EUR-Lex. Our own compilation, not an official record.
